title: Super Vibes 🎉
tagline: send good vibes to your frens and loved ones across the Superchain with personalized omnichain NFT cards
description:
Super Vibes 🎉 are personalized omnichain NFT cards, representing greeting cards, birthday cards, congratulations cards that we send to frens and loved ones for special moments and memories.

Super Vibes 🎉 (omnichain NFT) is powered by LayerZero's ONFT ERC721 contract deployed across the Superchain (Optimism, Base, Zora, Mode, etc ) Refer here for contract addresses: https://gist.github.com/0xStruct/052ae8e75f000255d64c2f2fd42dbf5c

Each NFT card has an emoji title to set the vibe and a personalized message. NFT can be minted in chosen chain and sent across to other chains in the Superchain.

- World ID is used to protect against bots
- Gasless mint is provided by Safe for better UX

Objectives of this project:
- Promote positivity through good vibes, loves and gratitutes
- day-to-day human interactions are now possible across Superchain via LayerZero
- memories are more long lasting (NFT)
- on-boarding web2 users to Superchain with strong use-cases
how_its_made:
How this project is made
- LayerZero's ONFT ERC721 contract is deployed across Superchain networks  (Optimism, Base, Zora, Mode, etc ) 
-- Refer here for contract addresses: https://gist.github.com/0xStruct/052ae8e75f000255d64c2f2fd42dbf5
- NFT cards can be minted on each chain
- NFT cards can be sent across various chains

- World ID is used to protect against bots
- Gasless mint is provided by Safe for better UX


Project uses NextJS for frontend dapp, and Solidity for smart contract.
